svg.title: Entropy Lab: twin oscillators
svg.desc: Plate seven, Computational Entropy Lab, traces illustrative: two oscillator traces scroll side by side, a smooth low-instability prompt signal and a jagged high-instability one, each beside an energy gauge whose needle wanders, with a question mark between them. The open question: does semantic instability in a prompt cost inference energy? A FastAPI and React research platform; synthetic demo data is flagged in the API.
